layers.title: Interfaces
layers.text: Front ends in React, Next.js and Vue. I spend a lot of time on Core Web Vitals, because a fast page is the feature people notice first.

layers.title: Services
layers.text: Django and FastAPI back ends, deployed on Ubuntu servers with Nginx and Docker.

layers.title: Content platforms
layers.text: Custom Drupal sites and modules, Drupal 8/9 to 10/11 migrations, and Backdrop CMS.

copy.heroLede: I’m a senior software engineer. For five years I’ve built **Drupal** sites and the **React, Next.js and Vue** front ends that sit on top of them. Lately I’ve been building with **Payload CMS**.
copy.stripLabel: What’s usually open on my machine
copy.stackHand: front end first, but I don’t stop there
copy.stackIntro: I started in front-end development and it’s still where I’m most at home. Agency work pulled me further down the stack, so these days I also write Drupal modules, build Django services and deploy the result myself.
copy.workIntro: One product of my own, and two side projects I made because I needed them.
copy.clientIntro: Sites and apps I’ve built for clients at Idlewild Digital and on my own: Drupal and Backdrop builds, Vue and Django apps, and a few early front-end projects.
copy.clientPageIntro: Everything I’ve shipped for clients, plus the front-end projects I learned on. Filter by the kind of build.
copy.experienceIntro: Full-time and on-site in Uttara, Dhaka, since July 2021. Three titles so far.
copy.ossIntro: Most of my open-source time goes to Backdrop CMS. I work the issue queue, submit bug fixes, and contribute modules and recipes back to backdropcms.org.
copy.contactIntro: Email is the best way to reach me. My work history is on LinkedIn, and the code is on GitHub.
